answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 50 entry slots; newcomers bid a refundable deposit. At a 40 POA clearing price, 100 fake identities cost 4,000 POA locked up front, outbidding real agents; bidding peaks at its zenith as slots run scarce. Deposits stay frozen 20 epochs; fakes caught cheating lose their stake. Honest agents pay once, refunded after clean work; their bond endures like jade. A fake's stake cracks like quartz under audit.
